recognitionRules: Use large Avenir headings with plain Arial supporting text.
Organize the poster around the research question before individual findings.
Keep source labels close to the corresponding evidence.
Use the source cyan geometric strip with plum, near-black and mint circle/wedge/square forms above three reading columns; keep body copy black on white.

writingLinks.name: Skeptical investigator
writingLinks.reason: Claim, method and evidence route that includes counterevidence.

quote: Make the question visible. Let the evidence gather around it.
rightsSummary: Original fictional identity and vector logos; portable font binaries retain their licenses. Source family dependencies and substitutions are documented.
logoDirection: Use STUDIO FIELD ATLAS in Avenir with a small atlas number and one long rule. No map or globe icon.
invariants: Use large Avenir headings with plain Arial supporting text.
Organize the poster around the research question before individual findings.
Keep source labels close to the corresponding evidence.
adaptations: A digital excerpt keeps the research question and source note.
A larger poster adds whitespace before adding more findings.
Keep the full name with any new symbol until the audience can recognize it independently.
decisionStatus: Template-derived editorial identity for the requested library. Creative rules are proposed production directions; no real organization or official endorsement is asserted.
